author: Linnaeus, 1766
status: 나그네새 수만 마리 · 여름철새 수백 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)

months.note: 산란기는 5–7월이고, 4–5월과 10월 이동기에 가장 많이 보이며 겨울에도 드물게 기록된다.

summary: 여름새로 와서 전국의 농경지, 초지, 구릉, 산기슭에서 지낸다. 암수가 저마다 홀로 생활하며, 풀밭이나 관목이 흩어진 초지에 둥지를 짓는다. 산란기는 5~7월로 한배에 알 5~7개를 낳고, 곤충을 먹는다. 국외에서는 일본, 중국 북부, 아무르, 사할린, 시베리아 동부에 분포한다.

points.en: black head, back, wings and tail
white patches on the neck sides and shoulders

sexes.male: 머리·등·날개·꼬리가 검고 가슴은 황갈색이며, 옆목과 어깨에 흰 반점이 있고 허리는 희다. 겨울에는 몸 대부분이 황갈색으로 바뀐다.
sexes.female: 윗면은 황갈색에 암회색 세로 줄무늬가 있고, 가슴과 옆구리는 적황색, 배는 회색빛이 도는 연노란색이다.

young: 어린새는 암컷과 비슷한 갈색 바탕에 윗면에는 담황색 얼룩, 가슴에는 갈색 세로줄이 있고 허리는 적갈색이다. 어린 수컷은 날개의 흰 반점이 일찍 나타나며, 첫 가을 수컷은 윗면이 갈색이고 얼굴과 멱이 거뭇하다.

art.subject: Stejneger's Stonechat (Saxicola torquatus, East Asian form often split as Saxicola stejnegeri), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen in Korean farmland from May to August: head, face and throat entirely black; mantle and back black, fresh birds with a few brown fringes; a white half-collar patch on each side of the neck; wings black with a white patch on the inner wing coverts; rump and uppertail coverts unstreaked white; tail black; breast deep orange-rufous, fading to whitish on the belly and flanks. Bill short, thin, black. Dark eye. Black legs.
art.pose: perched on top of a grass stem, side view
art.scene: Korean summer farmland edge: grassy fields and rolling hills with scattered shrubs at the foot of a mountain; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding (May–August), side view perched on a grass stem: black head and throat, white neck patch, black back, white shoulder patch on black wings, orange-rufous breast, whitish belly and flanks, white rump, black tail

adult male in fresh autumn plumage (September–October passage), side view: black head, throat and back largely veiled by broad buff-brown fringes, orange-buff breast, white neck and wing patches still visible, pale buff rump
adult female, side view perched: buff-brown upperparts streaked dark, pale buff throat, orange-buff breast and flanks, pale yellowish-buff belly, small white wing patch, unstreaked pale buff rump
art.build: Small, round-headed chat, 13cm, slightly smaller than a sparrow; upright stance on the tops of grass stems and low bushes, often flicking its wings and short tail. Bill short, thin, black. Legs slender, medium length, black. Wings fairly short. Tail short, black, square. In flight males show white wing patches and a white rump contrasting with the black back and tail.
avoid: Do not paint a white supercilium or a streaked crown on the male (Whinchat, Saxicola rubetra).
Do not paint orange outer tail feathers or orange underparts reaching the vent (redstarts).
Do not paint a black breast; the breast is orange-rufous below the black throat.
Do not paint a streaked rump on the male; it is clean white.
